faq.q: Can I make Shopify product photos from one photo each?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear picture per product and pick a square page or collection image. The credit cost shows before each file.

faq.q: What image size works on a product page?
faq.a: A square file around 2048 by 2048 pixels is a practical start. Check the image size your store is set to use before you upload.

faq.q: How do I make a collection look consistent?
faq.a: Use the same square crop and a related backdrop for every product, then compare the new tile beside the others in the grid.

faq.q: Do I need to reshoot older products?
faq.a: No. Start from the picture you already have for that item so older products can sit next to new ones.

faq.q: Can I add a clip on the product page?
faq.a: Yes. Make a clip of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds and add it in product media yourself. A still is 24 credits. Clip credits are 24, 40, 60 or 120 by length.

faq.q: Should a tall social clip sit in the product gallery?
faq.a: Keep square images in the gallery. Make the tall file as a separate job so the grid stays even.

faq.q: Are the files mine to put on the store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are yours to use. You set the product name and the price. We do not publish into Shopify.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Start with a clear, well-lit shot of the whole item. [how to take product photos for AI](/guides/product-photo-tips) walks through a source picture that gives the tool enough to work with.
